options.rationale: An 18-week completion-focused route with three training days per week, building running frequency before gradually extending the longer run. No finish-time target was chosen.
assumptions: The goal is to finish a half marathon; there is no time target.
No running pace or session duration was reported, so sessions use an easy effort and run-walk option rather than a pace target.
Progress checks are intended as guides, not guarantees; reduce or repeat a week if recovery is poor.

phases.title: Establish a regular routine
phases.progressCheck: Log three easy running sessions per week and build the longest session toward 4 km, adjusting if recovery is poor.

phases.title: Build comfortable distance
phases.progressCheck: Log three sessions per week and build the longest session toward 8 km at an easy, conversational effort.

phases.title: Extend endurance
phases.progressCheck: Build the longest easy session toward 14 km; record distance, duration, and how you felt the next day.

phases.title: Prepare to complete the distance
